name: CV-Bench-3D-gt3dloc
description: CV-Bench-3D-gt3dloc is a vision benchmark for 3D localization and pose estimation that measures how accurately algorithms recover 3D camera/object position and orientation from sensor data. It is intended to evaluate robustness and precision of 3D localization methods under varied scene conditions and sensor inputs.
reputation: Specialized dataset for 3D localization research with modest adoption among 3D vision and robotics practitioners.
